definitions.gloss: one after another; successively; in rapid succession
definitions.explanation: Describes multiple things or people appearing, arriving, or happening in quick succession without pause. Conveys a sense of continuous flow or momentum.

examples.japanese: {客|きゃく}が{続々|ぞくぞく}と{集|あつ}まった。
{新|あたら}しい{情報|じょうほう}が{続々|ぞくぞく}と{入|はい}ってくる。
examples.english: New information keeps pouring in one after another.

examples.japanese: {開店|かいてん}セールの{日|ひ}には、{朝|あさ}から{買|か}い{物客|ものきゃく}が{続々|ぞくぞく}と{店|みせ}に{押|お}し{寄|よ}せた。
examples.english: On the day of the opening sale, shoppers flocked to the store one after another from the morning.

notes:
USAGE:
{続々|ぞくぞく}と is an adverb describing things happening in rapid succession. The と particle is optional but commonly included. It is used with verbs of appearance, arrival, or emergence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {続々|ぞくぞく}と{集|あつ}まる (to gather one after another)
- {続々|ぞくぞく}と{届|とど}く (to arrive in succession)
- {続々|ぞくぞく}と{発売|はつばい}される (to be released one after another)
- {続々|ぞくぞく}と{参加|さんか}する (to join one after another)

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ぞくぞくする (to shiver, to get chills), which describes a physical sensation. {続々|ぞくぞく}と always modifies a verb describing successive events.
